Vulkan API headers from the Khronos Group (Vulkan-Headers, as shipped in Vulkan SDK 1.4.341.1).
Licence: Apache-2.0 OR MIT (see the SPDX line at the top of each header).
Only the C headers needed to call Vulkan are included: vulkan/vulkan_core.h, vk_platform.h, vulkan.h,
vulkan_win32.h and the vk_video headers vulkan_core.h refers to. Unmodified.
